intro.en: Most families find everything they need here, without crossing the city.
intro.am: አብዛኛው ቤተሰብ የሚፈልገውን ሁሉ ከተማ ሳያቋርጥ እዚሁ ያገኛል።

description.en: Fever, cough, stomach trouble, headaches, infections. See a doctor the same day, with tests done on the spot if you need them. We also follow up blood pressure, diabetes and asthma, so the doctor who knows your history is the one who adjusts your medicine.
description.am: ትኩሳት፣ ሳል፣ የሆድ ሕመም፣ ራስ ምታት፣ ኢንፌክሽን። በዕለቱ ሐኪም ያያሉ፤ ምርመራ ካስፈለገም እዚሁ ይሠራል። የደም ግፊት፣ የስኳርና የአስም ክትትልም እናደርጋለን፤ መድኃኒትዎን የሚያስተካክለው ታሪክዎን የሚያውቀው ሐኪም ነው።

description.en: A children's doctor for babies and children up to 14.
description.am: እስከ 14 ዓመት ላሉ ሕፃናትና ልጆች የሕፃናት ሐኪም።

description.en: Follow-up visits and ultrasound from the first weeks.
description.am: ከመጀመሪያዎቹ ሳምንታት ጀምሮ ክትትልና አልትራሳውንድ።

description.en: Blood, urine and stool tests. Most results in two hours.

description.en: Collect your medicine before you leave, with clear instructions.
description.am: መድኃኒትዎን ከግልጽ የአወሳሰድ መመሪያ ጋር ሳይወጡ ይውሰዱ።

description.en: Check-ups, cleaning and fillings, Tuesdays and Thursdays.
description.am: ምርመራ፣ እጥበትና ሙሌት፤ ማክሰኞና ሐሙስ።

intro.en: The same faces each visit, so you don't have to explain your story twice.
intro.am: በየጉብኝቱ የሚያውቋቸው ባለሙያዎች፤ ታሪክዎን ደጋግመው ማስረዳት አይኖርብዎትም።

alt.en: A smiling nurse in light-blue scrubs with a stethoscope
alt.am: ውሃ ሰማያዊ የሥራ ልብስ የለበሰች፣ ስቴቶስኮፕ ያንጠለጠለች ፈገግተኛ ነርስ

subtitle.en: Head nurse, mother and baby care

heading.en: Tests and answers in one visit

body.en:
Nobody who is unwell wants to be sent across town for a blood test. Our laboratory and ultrasound room are a few steps from the doctor's door.

You give your sample, wait in the lounge, and the doctor explains the result to you the same day.
body.am:
የታመመ ሰው ለደም ምርመራ ከተማ ማቋረጥ አይፈልግም። ላብራቶሪያችንና የአልትራሳውንድ ክፍላችን ከሐኪሙ በር ጥቂት እርምጃ ላይ ናቸው።

ናሙና ይሰጣሉ፣ በማረፊያው ይጠብቃሉ፣ ሐኪሙም በዕለቱ ውጤቱን ያስረዳዎታል።

alt.en: A lab technician in a white coat looking through a microscope
alt.am: ነጭ ጋውን የለበሰች የላብራቶሪ ባለሙያ በማይክሮስኮፕ ስትመለከት

points.en: Most results ready in two hours
Results sent to your Telegram if you ask
Prices told to you before any test

description.en: Send the form, call us, or just come. Booked patients are seen at their time.
description.am: ቅጹን ይላኩ፣ ይደውሉ ወይም በቀጥታ ይምጡ። ቀጠሮ ያላቸው በሰዓታቸው ይታያሉ።

description.en: A nurse takes your temperature and pressure, then the doctor listens and examines you.
description.am: ነርሷ ሙቀትና የደም ግፊት ትለካለች፤ ከዚያ ሐኪሙ አዳምጦ ይመረምርዎታል።

description.en: Lab and ultrasound are in the same building. You are told the price first.
description.am: ላብራቶሪና አልትራሳውንድ በዚሁ ሕንፃ ናቸው። ዋጋው አስቀድሞ ይነገርዎታል።

description.en: Medicine from our pharmacy, written advice, and a follow-up date if you need one.
description.am: ከመድኃኒት ቤታችን መድኃኒት፣ የጽሑፍ ምክር እና ካስፈለገ የክትትል ቀጠሮ።

quote.en: My son had a fever at night. We came in the morning, the test was done in an hour and he was better by the weekend.
quote.am: ልጄ ሌሊት ትኩሳት ነበረው። ጠዋት መጣን፣ ምርመራው በአንድ ሰዓት አለቀ፣ እስከ ሳምንቱ መጨረሻ ተሻለው።

quote.en: The doctor took time to explain my blood pressure medicine. Nobody rushed me.
quote.am: ሐኪሟ ስለ ደም ግፊት መድኃኒቴ ጊዜ ወስዳ አስረዳችኝ። ማንም አላጣደፈኝም።

quote.en: I did all my pregnancy follow-up here. The nurses knew my name from the second visit.
quote.am: የእርግዝና ክትትሌን በሙሉ እዚህ ነው ያደረግሁት። ነርሶቹ ከሁለተኛው ጉብኝት ጀምሮ በስሜ ያውቁኛል።

answer.en: No. You can walk in any time we are open. With an appointment you are seen at your time instead of waiting your turn.
answer.am: አያስፈልግም። ክፍት በሆንበት ሰዓት ሁሉ መምጣት ይችላሉ። ቀጠሮ ካለዎት ግን ተራ ሳይጠብቁ በሰዓትዎ ይታያሉ።

answer.en: A doctor's visit is 400 Birr. Tests and medicine are extra, and we tell you the price before we do anything.
answer.am: የሐኪም ምርመራ 400 ብር ነው። የላብራቶሪ ምርመራና መድኃኒት ተጨማሪ ናቸው፤ ከመሥራታችን በፊት ዋጋውን እንነግርዎታለን።

answer.en: Cash, Telebirr or bank transfer at the front desk.
answer.am: በጥሬ ገንዘብ፣ በቴሌብር ወይም በባንክ ዝውውር በእንግዳ መቀበያው።

question.en: When do I get lab results?

answer.en: Most are ready in about two hours. A few special tests take one or two days; we call you when they arrive.
answer.am: አብዛኛው በሁለት ሰዓት ገደማ ይደርሳል። ጥቂት ልዩ ምርመራዎች አንድ ወይም ሁለት ቀን ይወስዳሉ፤ ሲደርሱ እንደውልልዎታለን።

question.en: What if it is an emergency?

answer.en: Call us straight away during opening hours. We are not open at night: for a serious emergency after hours, go to the nearest hospital.
answer.am: በሥራ ሰዓታችን ወዲያውኑ ይደውሉልን። ሌሊት ክፍት አይደለንም፤ ከሥራ ሰዓት ውጭ ለከባድ ድንገተኛ ሕመም በአቅራቢያዎ ወዳለ ሆስፒታል ይሂዱ።

intro.en: Leave your name and number. We call you back within one working hour to agree a time. For anything urgent, please call instead.
intro.am: ስምዎንና ስልክዎን ይተዉልን። በአንድ የሥራ ሰዓት ውስጥ ደውለን ሰዓት እንይዝልዎታለን። አስቸኳይ ከሆነ ግን በቀጥታ ይደውሉ።

successMessage.en: Thank you. We will call you shortly to confirm your appointment.
